'''White Maw Pass''' was the proper name for the icy rift that the [[Glacial Fissure]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was named after. A large ice canyon, it featured small volcanoes along the canyon floor, and the [[Chilling Death Spire]] was constructed from the ice mountain that the ravine encircled. The [[Firefrost Lavaworks]] and the [[Firefrost Reactor Facility]] were both located in caves accessible from the the floor of the pass, and the [[Volcanic Trench]] and the [[Eruption Impasse]] were two offshoots of the White Maw Pass.
